name: Collectible
description:
There are 3 possible Collectibles:
Collectible: Ruin Grader: Add Omni Element dice until you have 2 Elemental Dice in total. For every 6 points of Adventure Experience your Hall of a Thousand Pillars has, increase this total by 1, up to a maximum of 4.
Collectible: Floating Dendro Fungus: Create 2 random Event Cards in your deck, then draw 2 cards. For every 4 points of Adventure Experience your Hall of a Thousand Pillars has, create and draw 1 additional card, up to 3 additional cards.
Collectible: Blubberbeast: Heal your most injured character for 2 HP. For every 4 points of Adventure Experience your Hall of a Thousand Pillars has, heal 1 additional HP, up to 3 additional HP.
